Renders one test tree row: status icon, optional adapter decoration + framework icon, status-colored name, duration, per-status count badges, and (when the runner exposes the handlers) rerun/stop buttons. Designed as the `renderRow` for the clicky `Tree`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/test-runner/TestTreeNode.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { TestTreeNode } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
